  "title": "REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES makes app not complaint with Google Play Policies",
  "body": "Currently, I have a problem when pushing an app to the Play Store. Due to the fact that the library uses the \r\nREQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission, the app gets rejected. \r\n\r\nThe attribute \"tools:node=remove\" in the manifest file has been removed from the \"uses-permission\" element. Previously, this was the only solution to remove the permission. I cannot seem to find an up-to-date solution anywhere.\r\n\r\nThe core use of the app does not require the permission and I would like to know how to remove the permission or how I can get Google to approve the app. \r\n\r\n\r\n",
